integrity: The bounds have a self-contained combinatorial proof; finite executable checks independently test the construction and small optima. No independent review or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: For k>=4, the exact minimum is bounded within one (even k) or two (odd k); no exact general equality is claimed. Verified finite cases do not replace the infinite combinatorial argument. Earlier equivalent results under alternate terminology remain a residual literature risk.
title: Near-exact cyclic coverage of all binary weight-two windows
